profile.name: Sacher电动可调谐激光器
profile.description: 这是一种通过电机驱动内部调谐机构来改变输出波长的可调谐激光器。设备可按设定波长或扫描速度进行调谐，常用于激光光谱、波长扫描、光学器件表征以及实验中激光波长的精细调整。
profile.description_en: This is a tunable laser whose output wavelength is adjusted by a motor-driven internal tuning mechanism. It can tune to a target wavelength or scan at a defined rate, and is commonly used for laser spectroscopy, wavelength scanning, optical component characterization, and fine wavelength adjustment in laboratory experiments.

registry.name: maxon EPOS2 Motor
registry.description: maxon EPOS2 Motor Controller是由maxon motor生产的物流/机械，主要功能包括位置设置、波长设置、运动控制。支持Signal, Slot, calc motor acc等操作。
